name: Bevy
description: A data-driven game engine built in Rust.
summary: Bevy allows careful, disclosed, human-driven AI assistance with code, but contributors must understand and review every submitted line and meet the normal quality bar. AI-generated media, prose, issues, PR descriptions, and general communication are prohibited, with a narrow exception for translating your own text if the original is included.

evidence.quote: We are wary of the use of AI in the development of Bevy, and are particularly troubled by its impact on artists, but tolerate careful human-driven AI use in some code-related areas consistent with the above values.
As a contributor, you are responsible for everything you submit.
You must personally understand every line of code or documentation that you put forward for review, and be able to articulate the design rationale and implementation tradeoffs when asked.
Work within your skill level and knowledge of the project.
Disclosure. Any use of AI to contribute to Bevy must be disclosed, with context about how it was used.
AI-assisted PRs will be held to the same rigorous standard of review: correctness, tests, rationale, incremental reviewable units, appropriate design and consensus building and so on.
No AI-generated prose. AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.
No AI-generated media. Images, 3d models, audio assets (and so on) submitted to Bevy may not be authored or modified with the use of generative AI tools.
AI-generated bug detection, research, or design input could be completely invisible, and while this was not barred, many community members were unhappy with such use.
No AI-authored commits. Only humans can be commit authors or listed as Co-authored-by.
Disclosure. Any use of AI to contribute to Bevy must be disclosed, with context about how it was used.
AI-generated bug detection, research, or design input could be completely invisible, and while this was not barred, many community members were unhappy with such use.
No AI-generated prose. AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.
No AI-generated communication. We want to talk to you, not a machine. Do not paste AI-generated output directly into conversations with humans, no matter where they take place.
No AI-generated prose. AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.
No AI-generated communication. We want to talk to you, not a machine. Do not paste AI-generated output directly into conversations with humans, no matter where they take place.
AI may be used to assist for translation and accessibility purposes, but please include the original untranslated text as well.
Disclosure. Any use of AI to contribute to Bevy must be disclosed, with context about how it was used.

Individual reviewers are empowered to request changes to contributions that fail to live up to these norms, or in cases where the work is not salvageable (commonly due to a lack of understanding by the original author), close them completely.
